sides.aggregates: count(System) as Systems, sum(SpaceHeaters) as SpaceHeaters, sum(PipeSegments) as PipeSegments

systems.sql: SELECT s.Name AS System, CASE WHEN s.Name LIKE '%VL%' THEN 'supply (VL)' WHEN s.Name LIKE '%RL%' THEN 'return (RL)' END AS Side, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.Category = 'IFCPIPESEGMENT') AS PipeSegments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.Category = 'IFCPIPEFITTING') AS PipeFittings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.Category = 'IFCSPACEHEATER') AS SpaceHeaters, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.Category = 'IFCVALVE') AS Valves FROM EntityText s LEFT JOIN RelationText r ON r.EntityIndexB = s.EntityIndex AND r.RelationType = 'MemberOf' LEFT JOIN EntityText a ON a.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexA WHERE s.Category = 'IFCSYSTEM' GROUP BY s.Name ORDER BY Side DESC, length(s.Name), s.Name
